title: Systemic KPI Manipulation — Brazilian Regulatory Fraud via Case Fragmentation, Flight Data Irregularities, and GRU Operational Negligence

confidence.note: Pattern of case fragmentation and impossible connection scheduling is documented. ANAC’s prior investigation of LATAM for KPI manipulation (2023) establishes the practice. Case update rates this as HIGH strength, cross‑references BR‑013, BR‑014, BR‑019, BR‑020.

incident.location: Guarulhos International Airport (GRU), Brazil / Santiago, Chile

incident_timestamp_display: Ongoing from April 2024 (GRU) through 2025 (complaint handling). Key indicia: GRU operational negligence and subsequent SCL incident’s complaint fragmentation.
allegation_summary: LATAM systematically manipulated KPIs and regulatory metrics through: (1) fragmenting a single consumer incident into 8 separate case numbers, artificially improving complaint resolution statistics and hindering proper investigation; (2) maintaining operationally infeasible connection scheduling (e.g., the GRU‑GYN connection on 4 April 2024 was virtually impossible, guaranteeing a missed connection); and (3) exhibiting operational negligence at GRU that aligned with systematic procedural failures. ANAC had previously investigated LATAM for KPI manipulation in 2023, yet dismissed the passenger’s 2025 complaint covering the same practices, revealing inconsistent regulatory treatment. The abuse of case fragmentation and the creation of fraudulent connection metrics constitute an abusive practice under CDC Art. 39 and a violation of the principles of administrative morality and efficiency (Lei 9.784/99, Art. 2).

articles.article_name: CDC, Art. 39 – Vedação geral de práticas abusivas (caput) e incisos pertinentes (recusa de atendimento, vantagem excessiva, etc.)
Lei 9.784/99, Art. 2 – Princípios da Administração Pública, incluindo moralidade, razoabilidade e eficiência

candidate_articles.preliminary_view: É vedado ao fornecedor de produtos ou serviços, dentre outras práticas abusivas: I — condicionar o fornecimento de produto ou serviço ao fornecimento de outro produto ou serviço; V — exigir do consumidor vantagem manifestamente excessiva.

verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for BR.LEI9784.C1.Art.2 and confirm excerpt
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: A Administração Pública obedecerá, dentre outros, aos princípios da legalidade, finalidade, motivação, razoabilidade, proporcionalidade, moralidade, ampla defesa, contraditório, segurança jurídica, interesse público e eficiência.
candidate_articles.history_note: Replaced Lei 12.846/2013 (Clean Companies Act) which was applied 'by_analogy' and is doctrinally weak for KPI manipulation claims. Lei 9.784 Art. 2 provides stronger administrative procedure anchor — ANAC's inconsistent treatment (investigating KPI manipulation in 2023 but dismissing identical consumer complaint in 2025) violates the principle of isonomy/consistency in administrative action.

verification_required: Fetch verbatim text of CL.CPR.Art.19 No.4 from BCN Ley Chile, confirm scope of protection and whether it binds private entities directly.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: El artículo 19 N°4 de la Constitución Política de la República asegura a todas las personas 'el respeto y protección a la vida privada y a la honra de la persona y su familia'. La carta entregada por LATAM con acusaciones no probadas de agresión y entrada sin autorización podría afectar la honra del pasajero, configurando una posible vulneración constitucional.
candidate_articles.history_note: Added as plausible candidate given false accusations identified in passenger interaction.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Duty to Provide Truthful Information (Consumer Law Art. 30)
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.LPC.Art.30 and confirm obligation to inform truthfully in consumer relations.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: El artículo 30 de la Ley N°19.496 sobre Protección de los Derechos de los Consumidores establece la obligación del proveedor de informar veraz y oportunamente al consumidor. Al entregar una carta con acusaciones falsas o no verificadas sobre el pasajero, LATAM podría estar incumpliendo dicho deber de información veraz.
candidate_articles.history_note: Analogous to BR.CDC.T1.C5.Art.39 but under Chilean consumer law.

verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.CC.Art.2314 and confirm applicability to false accusations causing moral damage.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: El artículo 2314 del Código Civil dispone que quien comete un delito o cuasidelito que cause daño a otro está obligado a indemnizar. La conducta de LATAM al imputar hechos falsos podría constituir un ilícito civil que, de acreditarse, generaría responsabilidad extracontractual por el daño moral sufrido por el pasajero.
candidate_articles.history_note: Selected as a foundational tort provision in Chilean civil law.

candidate_articles.candidate_name: Data Accuracy Obligation (Data Protection Law Art. 7)
verification_required: Fetch verbatim text for CL.L19628.Art.7 and confirm obligation to maintain accurate personal data.
candidate_articles.preliminary_view: El artículo 7 de la Ley N°19.628 sobre Protección de la Vida Privada establece que los datos personales deben ser exactos y actualizados. Si LATAM mantiene en sus registros acusaciones falsas sobre el pasajero, estaría infringiendo el principio de calidad del dato, pudiendo dar lugar a reclamación conforme a esta ley.
candidate_articles.history_note: Added due to potential data processing violation when airline recorded unverified accusations.
